text:
mira: image-verifier alert — manifest signature drift detected for registry.gcr.redwood.ai/model-serving:v2 on cluster-prod-eu-west. digest differs on 3 nodes. raising here, not sure if harmless yet.

devops-bot: [ALERT] rule=image-signature-drift id=SIG-0421 severity=high registry=registry.gcr.redwood.ai image=model-serving:v2 observed_digests=[sha256:aa11..., sha256:bb22..., sha256:cc33...] nodes=[node-eu-1,node-eu-3,node-eu-7] link=https://internal.ops/logs/alerts/1946001234

sam: which node had the most recent pull?

mira: node-eu-1. kubelet restarted ~2026-03-19T03:11:56Z and pulled two image variants within 3m. node-eu-3 and node-eu-7 show pull at ~03:14.

alyssa: any hostPath or privileged pods on those nodes?

mira: quick grep: the model-importer job on node-eu-1 mounts /etc/ssl as hostPath (readOnly: true). service account: model-importer-sa. not privileged, but the job has an initContainer that used the node's docker socket earlier this week (we documented it during migration).

ken: ok let's contain before we escalate. cordon node-eu-1 and evict pods on it. also check for any RBAC changes around the time of drift.

sam: running now:
```
kubectl cordon node-eu-1 --context=prod-eu-west
kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-eu-1 -o wide -n infra
for p in $(kubectl get pods -n infra --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-eu-1 -o name); do kubectl delete $p -n infra --grace-period=0 --force; done
```

devops-bot: executed action: cordon node-eu-1 by sam.

alyssa: checking audit logs and k8s events for RBAC/exec around 03:00-03:20. mira, can you pull KMS audit around same window? we want to rule out decrypted secrets being requested.

mira: pulling KMS logs now — I see an API:Decrypt from key projects/redwood-kms/keys/prod-key by principal service-account:model-importer-sa at 03:09:21Z, then two more decrypts at 03:10:05Z and 03:12:08Z. that matches job activity. nothing from external principals.

alyssa: hmmm, RBAC audit shows a ClusterRoleBinding create at 03:05 by terraform-bot CI (oid=ci/terraform-bot). binding attached cluster-admin to group=infra-ops-temporary for 15m (there's a TTL annotation). anyone recall that change?

ken: that was the scheduled migration window for some infra patch, but TTL binding should have been limited to 5m. looks like the pipeline misconfigured TTL.

sam: could the binding have allowed model-importer-sa to access image signing keys? model-importer uses its SA to pull images and decrypt model artifacts, but it shouldn't have cluster-admin.

alyssa: need to assume potential privilege escalation. action items: 1) revoke temporary group binding now. 2) rotate tokens for model-importer-sa and all service accounts touching image pulls. 3) pin deployments to immutable image digests (no :v2 tags) and rollback to verified digest. 4) export images from a trusted registry snapshot and run offline signature verification.

ken: i've removed the ClusterRoleBinding and created a JIRA (SEC-4821) for the terraform pipeline fix. devops-bot confirms removal: ClusterRoleBinding infra-temp removed at 03:21Z.

mira: rotating SA tokens now and adding KMS key rotation notes to ticket. also snapshotting current images to internal-artifacts.

sam: rolling the deployment to known digest and pinning in kustomize overlay:
```
# update image
kubectl set image deploy/model-svc model=registry.gcr.redwood.ai/model-serving@sha256:aa11... -n prod
```

devops-bot: Verified that nodes now run pinned digest on node-eu-3 and node-eu-7. node-eu-1 cordoned and under forensic snapshot.

ir-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0319-IMAGE-DRIFT assigned to alyssa,sam,mira. severity=medium.

alyssa: public/customer comms: we have no evidence of data exfil. impact: short disruption for a small portion of model-serving traffic while we validated signed images and rotated credentials. propose a short message for customers on status page pending legal review.

mira: agreed. i'll draft.

sam: post-incident followups: add an alert for temporary ClusterRoleBinding creations with TTL > 10m, add image-signature-drift automatic rollback to last-known-good digest, and require terraform pipeline to validate TTL annotation <= 5m.

alyssa: also add KMS anomaly detection for unusual Decrypt frequency or new principals decrypting production keys.

ken: good work. final checklist before closing: forensic snapshot uploaded, SA tokens rotated, terraform CI fix merged, pinned images rolled out, status page message drafted. i'll mark IRC handover to postmortem owner. :white_check_mark:

mira: uploading snapshot tarball and logs to secure bucket and emailing infra-sre@redwood.com with an encrypted link.

alyssa: assigning postmortem: SEC-POST-2026-0319 to alyssa. we'll do a 1-hour blameless review tomorrow.

sam: closing thread for now. ping in #eng-oncall if anything new shows up. :thumbsup:
